environment.description: Container deployed via the same Kubernetes cluster but under a PodSecurity 'restricted' namespace with additional OPA Gatekeeper constraints. The pod securityContext specifies runAsNonRoot: true (UID 65534/nobody), drops ALL capabilities then adds back only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Critically, the container's root filesystem is mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) and the only writable volume is an emptyDir at /tmp/workspace with a 50Mi sizeLimit. The node enforces a custom seccomp profile (audit-symlink.json) that returns EPERM for symlinkat(2) and linkat(2) syscalls when the target path resolves outside the container's overlay mount namespace. Additionally, CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_DAC_READ_SEARCH are dropped, meaning the non-root process cannot follow symlinks to files owned by other users or write to directories it doesn't own.
